papers.title: Integrated wastewater and clinical genomic surveillance for high-resolution tracking of measles virus evolution and transmission.
papers.abstract: Abstract Measles outbreaks have surged globally, challenging surveillance and control efforts. In South Africa, the 2024−2025 measles outbreak led to nearly 4,000 reported cases, triggering a nationwide vaccination campaign. However, tracking measles virus (MeV; species Morbillivirus hominis ) transmission and evolution remains difficult at scale, particularly in settings with limited access to care, diagnostic testing and sequencing capacity. Wastewater can enable population-scale virus surveillance, but low MeV concentrations limit detection sensitivity and sequencing quality. Here we show that overcoming these technical challenges enables integrated wastewater and clinical genomic surveillance that expands the coverage and resolution of MeV monitoring. We developed a virus concentration and whole-genome sequencing (WGS) workflow and applied it to 4,502 wastewater samples collected across all nine provinces of South Africa during the 2024−2025 outbreak. Wastewater MeV genotype prevalence tracked clinical estimates, and phylogenetic analyses combining wastewater and clinical sequences revealed geographically structured transmission and previously undetected inter-provincial spread. WGS recovered transmission links not captured by the field standard approach, which targets a 450-nucleotide region of the nucleoprotein gene (N450), highlighting the importance of WGS to accurately characterize transmission dynamics. Our study provides a cost-effective and scalable genomic surveillance approach to support measles control and elimination.

papers.title: North America's measles reversal: Canada has lost elimination status, and the United States is next.
papers.abstract: The region of the Americas achieved measles elimination in 2016, reflecting sustained vaccination coverage and strong surveillance systems. However, North America is now experiencing a marked resurgence. Canada formally lost measles elimination status on November 10, 2025, following more than 12 months of continuous transmission, and the United States is projected to lose its status in November 2026. Epidemiologic trends underscore the magnitude of reversal. Canada reported 5461 measles cases in 2025 and 1121 additional cases in 2026 (as of October 3), compared with only 146 cases in 2024. In the United States, 2288 cases and 48 outbreaks were documented in 2025 and 4410 additional cases in 2026 (as of October 15), up from only 285 cases and 16 outbreaks in 2024. Notably, 90% of US cases were outbreak-associated in 2025, 93% occurred among unvaccinated or unknown-status individuals, 11% required hospitalization, and three deaths in 2025 were recorded - the first in a decade. Regional data from the Pan American Health Organization documented 14,503 cases and 32 deaths across the Americas in 2025, with 55,792 cases and 77 deaths in 2026 (as of October 3). Declining vaccination coverage is central to this resurgence, with US kindergarten measles-mumps-rubella coverage falling to 92.5%, below the 95% threshold estimated to support measles population immunity. Contributing factors include expansion of nonmedical exemptions, weak enforcement of school-entry requirements, fragmented immunization infrastructures, underfunded public health systems, and increasing vaccine hesitancy amplified by misinformation. Restoring elimination status will require coordinated policy and programmatic action, including strengthening vaccination mandates, improving surveillance and immunization registries, enhancing community engagement, and rebuilding public trust in vaccines. Failure to act risks sustained transmission, preventable morbidity, and mortality, particularly in children in the Americas.

papers.title: Preliminary safety observations following measles-mumps-rubella vaccination in natalizumab-treated patients with multiple sclerosis: a case series in the context of rising measles incidence in Italy.
papers.abstract: BACKGROUND: In Natalizumab (NTZ)-treated patients, only inactivated vaccines are proven safe; live vaccines require caution. Italy shows a measles resurgence, mainly in unvaccinated people with notable complications. Vaccine coverage is insufficient. OBJECTIVES: Given rising risk, our multiple sclerosis Disease Management Team endorsed measles vaccination during NTZ therapy for susceptible patients, consistent with prior selective VZV vaccination. RESULTS: To date, 11 patients have been vaccinated with the Measles-Mumps-Rubella (MMR) vaccine during NTZ treatment at our centre. In three cases, co-administration with the VZV vaccine was necessary. None of the patients who received the vaccine developed vaccine-associated adverse reactions or VZV infection. CONCLUSIONS: Management of MS requires an integrated approach that balances immunosuppressive treatment risks with preventive strategies, such as vaccination, to reduce infection risk while ensuring patient safety. Larger patient cohorts are needed to confirm our preliminary findings.
authors: Multiple Sclerosis Disease Management Team (MS DMT)

papers.title: Measles in adults: emergency department identification and management.
papers.abstract: Increasing numbers of measles outbreaks in the United States have renewed the need for rapid recognition and management in emergency departments. Although adult presentations vary, emergency clinicians must recognize the classic prodrome and identify patients at risk for severe disease. Prompt airborne precautions, appropriate diagnostic testing, and timely postexposure prophylaxis are essential to limit healthcare-associated and community transmission. This review summarizes the clinical features, diagnosis, complications, and evidence-based management of measles in adults in the emergency department.

papers.title: Measles and rubella IgM positivity and case classification accuracy in Mozambique's national case-based surveillance system, 2016–2021
papers.abstract: Abstract Introduction: Mozambique adopted case-based surveillance for measles and rubella in 2016. This study aimed to characterise clinically suspected cases and assess serological and epidemiological data quality. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional study using data from the national surveillance system, 2016–2021. Per national protocol, all clinically suspected cases (fever and generalised rash) are tested for measles and rubella IgM. Analyses used cases with valid (adequate specimen and clear result) measles IgM results (n = 12,674), rubella IgM results (n = 12,177), or both (n = 12,143). Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with IgM positivity. Results Of 15,782 suspected cases, 12,708 (81%) had at least one valid IgM result (12,674 for measles and 12,177 for rubella). Among those tested for both (n = 12,143), IgM was positive for measles in 1,581 (13%), for rubella in 993 (8.2%), and for both in 424 (3.5%). Among those with any IgM result (n = 12,708), 4,368 (34%) had specimens collected in the optimal collection window (4–28 days for measles; 6–28 days for rubella) after rash onset, and 597 (4.8%) had received measles-containing vaccine ≤ 28 days before sample collection. Among confirmed measles cases (n = 1,697), 424 (25%) were also rubella IgM-positive; among confirmed rubella cases (n = 996), 424 (43%) were also measles IgM-positive. All provinces consistently reported cases and submitted samples. Positivity was higher in the northern and central regions versus the southern region, among those vaccinated 8–28 days before sample collection, and among those sampled in the optimal window versus ≤ 3 days after rash onset (measles: 16% vs 12%; adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 1.2 [1.0–1.3]). Conclusion The high proportion of co-positive cases, together with elevated IgM positivity among recently vaccinated individuals, may reflect vaccine-induced IgM or cross-reactive serology. IgM serology alone is insufficient for accurate case classification without integration of vaccination history and epidemiological context. Surveillance systems that achieve higher completeness of documentation, appropriate sample timing, and consistent application of classification criteria are better positioned to generate accurate incidence estimates and detect outbreaks promptly.

analysis.summary_en: This study evaluated the accuracy of measles and rubella IgM positivity in Mozambique's national case-based surveillance system from 2016 to 2021. It aimed to characterise clinically suspected cases and assess the quality of serological and epidemiological data. A cross-sectional design was used, incorporating data from all provinces. The study found that 81% of suspected cases had at least one valid IgM result, with 13% positive for measles and 8.2% for rubella. Co-positive cases were common, and IgM positivity was higher among recently vaccinated individuals. The authors suggest that these findings may reflect vaccine-induced IgM or cross-reactive serology. They highlight the need for integrating vaccination history and epidemiological context to improve case classification accuracy. The study's results indicate that better documentation, sample timing, and classification criteria can enhance surveillance systems' ability to generate accurate incidence estimates and detect outbreaks. The evidence is strong, with high confidence in the findings due to the comprehensive data collection and statistical methods used.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 本研究旨在描述临床疑似病例的特征并评估血清学和流行病学数据的质量。莫桑比克于 2016 年针对 麻疹 和风疹采用了基于病例的 麻疹。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用 2016-2021 年国家 监测 系统的数据进行了一项横断面研究。分析具有有效 麻疹 IgM 结果 (n = 12,674)、风疹 IgM 结果 (n = 12,177) 或两者 (n = 12,143) 的已用病例。
elements_zh.methods: 多变量逻辑回归确定了与 IgM 阳性相关的因素。根据国家方案,所有临床疑似病例(发烧和全身皮疹)均需接受 麻疹 和风疹 IgM 检测。
elements_zh.main_results: 在 15,782 例疑似病例中,12,708 例(81%)至少有一项有效的 IgM 结果(麻疹 为 12,674 例,风疹为 12,177 例)。在接受这两种检测的人中 (n = 12,143),麻疹 IgM 呈阳性的人数为 1,581 人 (13%),风疹 IgM 呈阳性的人数为 993 人 (8.2%),两者均呈阳性的人数为 424 人 (3.5%)。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 联合阳性病例的比例很高,加上最近接种疫苗的个体中 IgM 阳性率升高,可能反映了 疫苗 诱导的 IgM 或交叉反应 血清学。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 如果不整合 疫苗接种 病史和流行病学背景,仅 IgM 血清学 不足以进行准确的病例分类。监测 系统实现了更高的文档完整性、适当的采样时间和一致的分类标准应用,可以更好地生成准确的 发病率 估计值并及时检测 暴发。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 提供的证据并未报告研究设计的具体局限性。基于全面的数据收集和统计分析,研究结果的可信度很高。

papers.title_zh: 2016-2021 年莫桑比克国家基于病例的 麻疹 和风疹 IgM 阳性率以及病例分类准确性
papers.source_body_en: Abstract Introduction: Mozambique adopted case-based surveillance for measles and rubella in 2016. This study aimed to characterise clinically suspected cases and assess serological and epidemiological data quality. Methods We conducted a cross-sectional study using data from the national surveillance system, 2016–2021. Per national protocol, all clinically suspected cases (fever and generalised rash) are tested for measles and rubella IgM. Analyses used cases with valid (adequate specimen and clear result) measles IgM results (n = 12,674), rubella IgM results (n = 12,177), or both (n = 12,143). Multivariable logistic regression identified factors associated with IgM positivity. Results Of 15,782 suspected cases, 12,708 (81%) had at least one valid IgM result (12,674 for measles and 12,177 for rubella). Among those tested for both (n = 12,143), IgM was positive for measles in 1,581 (13%), for rubella in 993 (8.2%), and for both in 424 (3.5%). Among those with any IgM result (n = 12,708), 4,368 (34%) had specimens collected in the optimal collection window (4–28 days for measles; 6–28 days for rubella) after rash onset, and 597 (4.8%) had received measles-containing vaccine ≤ 28 days before sample collection. Among confirmed measles cases (n = 1,697), 424 (25%) were also rubella IgM-positive; among confirmed rubella cases (n = 996), 424 (43%) were also measles IgM-positive. All provinces consistently reported cases and submitted samples. Positivity was higher in the northern and central regions versus the southern region, among those vaccinated 8–28 days before sample collection, and among those sampled in the optimal window versus ≤ 3 days after rash onset (measles: 16% vs 12%; adjusted odds ratio [AOR] = 1.2 [1.0–1.3]). Conclusion The high proportion of co-positive cases, together with elevated IgM positivity among recently vaccinated individuals, may reflect vaccine-induced IgM or cross-reactive serology. IgM serology alone is insufficient for accurate case classification without integration of vaccination history and epidemiological context. Surveillance systems that achieve higher completeness of documentation, appropriate sample timing, and consistent application of classification criteria are better positioned to generate accurate incidence estimates and detect outbreaks promptly.
papers.abstract_zh: 摘要简介:莫桑比克于2016年针对麻疹和风疹采用了基于病例的监测。本研究旨在描述临床疑似病例的特征并评估血清学和流行病学数据的质量。方法 我们使用 2016-2021 年国家 监测 系统的数据进行了一项横断面研究。根据国家方案,所有临床疑似病例(发烧和全身皮疹)均需接受 麻疹 和风疹 IgM 检测。分析具有有效(充足样本和明确结果)麻疹 IgM 结果 (n = 12,674)、风疹 IgM 结果 (n = 12,177) 或两者 (n = 12,143) 的已用病例。多变量逻辑回归确定了与 IgM 阳性相关的因素。结果 在 15,782 例疑似病例中,12,708 例(81%)至少有一项有效 IgM 结果(麻疹 为 12,674 例,风疹为 12,177 例)。在接受这两种检测的人中 (n = 12,143),麻疹 IgM 呈阳性的人数为 1,581 人 (13%),风疹 IgM 呈阳性的人数为 993 人 (8.2%),两者均呈阳性的人数为 424 人 (3.5%)。在具有任何 IgM 结果的患者中 (n = 12,708),4,368 例 (34%) 在皮疹发病后的最佳采集窗口(麻疹 为 4-28 天;风疹为 6-28 天)采集了标本,597 例 (4.8%) 在样本采集前 28 天以内接受了含有 麻疹 的 疫苗。在确诊的 麻疹 病例 (n = 1,697) 中,有 424 例 (25%) 风疹 IgM 呈阳性;在确诊的风疹病例 (n = 996) 中,424 例 (43%) 也为 麻疹 IgM 阳性。各省份均一致报告病例并提交样本。北部和中部地区的阳性率高于南部地区,在样本采集前 8-28 天接种疫苗的人群中,以及在最佳窗口内采样的人群中,与皮疹发病后 ≤ 3 天以内采样的人群中,阳性率较高(麻疹:16% vs 12%;调整后的比值比 [AOR] = 1.2 [1.0-1.3])。结论 近期接种疫苗的个体中,高比例的共阳性病例以及 IgM 阳性率升高,可能反映了 疫苗 诱导的 IgM 或交叉反应性 血清学。如果不整合 疫苗接种 病史和流行病学背景,仅 IgM 血清学 不足以进行准确的病例分类。监测 系统实现了更高的文档完整性、适当的采样时间和一致的分类标准应用,可以更好地生成准确的 发病率 估计值并及时检测 暴发。

papers.title: Diffusion Tensor Imaging in Patients with Subacute Sclerosing Panencephalitis: a Prospective Follow-up Study.
papers.abstract: PURPOSE: Conventional MRI may underestimate disease burden in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). Clinical disease stage and conventional neuroimaging often do not correlate. We evaluated diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) abnormalities across clinical stages and their longitudinal changes over six months. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate DTI abnormalities across clinical stages of SSPE and assess longitudinal changes in fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) over six months. METHODS: In this prospective study, 41 patients with SSPE (Stage II: n = 15; Stage III: n = 26) and 15 age-matched healthy controls underwent MRI with DTI. We measured fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) across multiple predefined brain regions and tracts. Differences in FA and MD values across groups were assessed using the Kruskal-Wallis test, followed by pairwise Mann-Whitney U tests for between-group comparisons. For pairwise comparisons, the magnitude of between-group differences was expressed as the mean difference with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Longitudinal changes in FA and MD values from baseline to the 6‐month follow-up within the same patients were assessed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test. To account for multiple comparisons across the predefined brain regions and white matter tracts, p-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) procedure, and FDR-adjusted q‐values were reported. A two-sided p-value or FDR-adjusted q‐value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. RESULTS: SSPE patients demonstrated reduced FA and increased MD compared with healthy controls, with more extensive abnormalities in Stage III disease. DTI abnormalities were detected even in patients with normal conventional MRI. At six months, FA decreased and MD increased in most examined regions, indicating progressive loss of white-matter integrity despite treatment. In intraindividual analysis, the splenium of the corpus callosum demonstrated relatively consistent FA reduction and MD increase, whereas the occipital and parietal white matter showed greater interindividual heterogeneity despite significant group-level changes. CONCLUSION: DTI demonstrates progressive white-matter abnormalities in SSPE that may not be fully captured by conventional MRI. The relatively consistent longitudinal FA and MD changes in the splenium of the corpus callosum suggest that it may serve as an imaging biomarker for monitoring disease progression; however, its validation in larger longitudinal cohorts is needed.

papers.title_zh: 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 患者的弥散张量成像:一项前瞻性随访研究。
papers.source_body_en: PURPOSE: Conventional MRI may underestimate disease burden in subacute sclerosing panencephalitis (SSPE). Clinical disease stage and conventional neuroimaging often do not correlate. We evaluated diffusion tensor imaging (DTI) abnormalities across clinical stages and their longitudinal changes over six months. OBJECTIVE: To evaluate DTI abnormalities across clinical stages of SSPE and assess longitudinal changes in fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) over six months. METHODS: In this prospective study, 41 patients with SSPE (Stage II: n = 15; Stage III: n = 26) and 15 age-matched healthy controls underwent MRI with DTI. We measured fractional anisotropy (FA) and mean diffusivity (MD) across multiple predefined brain regions and tracts. Differences in FA and MD values across groups were assessed using the Kruskal-Wallis test, followed by pairwise Mann-Whitney U tests for between-group comparisons. For pairwise comparisons, the magnitude of between-group differences was expressed as the mean difference with corresponding 95% confidence intervals (CIs). Longitudinal changes in FA and MD values from baseline to the 6‐month follow-up within the same patients were assessed using the Wilcoxon signed-rank test. To account for multiple comparisons across the predefined brain regions and white matter tracts, p-values were adjusted using the Benjamini-Hochberg false discovery rate (FDR) procedure, and FDR-adjusted q‐values were reported. A two-sided p-value or FDR-adjusted q‐value < 0.05 was considered statistically significant. RESULTS: SSPE patients demonstrated reduced FA and increased MD compared with healthy controls, with more extensive abnormalities in Stage III disease. DTI abnormalities were detected even in patients with normal conventional MRI. At six months, FA decreased and MD increased in most examined regions, indicating progressive loss of white-matter integrity despite treatment. In intraindividual analysis, the splenium of the corpus callosum demonstrated relatively consistent FA reduction and MD increase, whereas the occipital and parietal white matter showed greater interindividual heterogeneity despite significant group-level changes. CONCLUSION: DTI demonstrates progressive white-matter abnormalities in SSPE that may not be fully captured by conventional MRI. The relatively consistent longitudinal FA and MD changes in the splenium of the corpus callosum suggest that it may serve as an imaging biomarker for monitoring disease progression; however, its validation in larger longitudinal cohorts is needed.
papers.abstract_zh: 目的:传统 MRI 可能低估 亚急性硬化性全脑炎 (SSPE) 的疾病负担。临床疾病阶段和常规神经影像学通常不相关。我们评估了各个临床阶段的弥散张量成像(DTI)异常及其在六个月内的纵向变化。目的:评估 SSPE 临床阶段的 DTI 异常,并评估六个月内分数各向异性 (FA) 和平均扩散率 (MD) 的纵向变化。方法:在这项前瞻性研究中,41 名 SSPE 患者(II 期:n = 15;III 期:n = 26)和 15 名年龄匹配的健康对照接受了 MRI 和 DTI 扫描。我们测量了多个预定义大脑区域和束的分数各向异性 (FA) 和平均扩散率 (MD)。使用 Kruskal-Wallis 检验评估各组 FA 和 MD 值的差异,然后使用成对 Mann-Whitney U 检验进行组间比较。对于成对比较,组间差异的大小表示为具有相应 95% 置信区间 (CI) 的平均差异。使用 Wilcoxon 符号秩检验评估同一患者 FA 和 MD 值从基线到 6 个月随访的纵向变化。为了解释预定义大脑区域和白质束之间的多重比较,使用 Benjamini-Hochberg 错误发现率 (FDR) 程序调整 p 值,并报告 FDR 调整后的 q 值。双边 p 值或 FDR 调整的 q 值 < 0.05 被认为具有统计显着性。结果:与健康对照相比,SSPE 患者表现出 FA 减少和 MD 增加,并且 III 期疾病有更广泛的异常。即使在常规 MRI 正常的患者中也能检测到 DTI 异常。六个月时,大多数检查区域的 FA 下降,MD 增加,表明尽管存在 治疗,但白质完整性逐渐丧失。在个体内分析中,胼胝体压部表现出相对一致的 FA 减少和 MD 增加,而枕叶和顶叶白质显示出更大的个体间异质性,尽管群体水平存在显着变化。结论:DTI 显示 SSPE 中进行性白质异常,而传统 MRI 可能无法完全捕获这些异常。胼胝体压部相对一致的纵向 FA 和 MD 变化表明,其可作为监测疾病进展的影像生物标志物;然而,需要在更大的纵向 队列研究 中进行验证。

papers.title: Kindergarten measles vaccination coverage and the 2025–2026 measles resurgence in the United States: a state-level analysis of public surveillance data
papers.abstract: Abstract Background In November 2026, the United States lost the measles elimination status it had held since 2000. This study examined whether states with lower kindergarten measles, mumps and rubella (MMR) vaccination coverage had more measles during the 2025–2026 resurgence, and how coverage changed before, during and after the COVID-19 pandemic. Methods In this ecological study, kindergarten MMR coverage and non-medical exemptions (CDC SchoolVaxView, 2009–10 to 2025–26) were combined with state and county measles case counts, census population estimates and national data for Canada and Mexico. Associations were assessed with Spearman correlation and negative binomial regression. Results National coverage fell from 95.2% in 2019–20 to 92.4% in 2025–26, and non-medical exemptions rose from 2.2% to 4.0%. Coverage dropped in most states during the pandemic and did not recover afterward. Measles cases averaged 410 per year before the pandemic, 61 during it and 2,011 after it. Each 1-percentage-point decrease in coverage was associated with 15% more cases (incidence rate ratio 1.15, 95% CI 1.01–1.31), although the association was sensitive to the exclusion of single states and coverage did not predict large outbreaks. Of 8,025 cases with county data, 96.8% were locally acquired, and half occurred in 18 counties or health regions. Conclusions Kindergarten MMR coverage fell during the pandemic and has not recovered. States with lower coverage had more measles, and cases were concentrated in a few counties. Restoring coverage above 95% is needed to re-establish elimination.

papers.title: KINDERGARTEN NONMEDICAL EXEMPTIONS AND CLUSTERED MEASLES CASES ACROSS US COUNTIES DURING THE 2025 RESURGENCE
papers.abstract: Background: The 2025 US measles resurgence was concentrated in communities with low vaccination coverage. Aggregate national and state measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) coverage can mask local susceptibility: pockets of unvaccinated children persist where average coverage appears adequate. School-entry nonmedical exemptions (NMEs) are collected routinely and may capture vaccination behavior and clustering of susceptible children. We examined whether county-level kindergarten NME rates were associated with reporting at least 3 measles cases in 2025, independently of average county MMR coverage. Methods: Cross-sectional ecological study of US counties. Confirmed cases reported January 1 to December 31, 2025, came from the Johns Hopkins University US Measles Tracker. Kindergarten MMR coverage and NME rates (school year 2023-2024 or, if unavailable, 2022- 2023) came from public state reports and published county-level compilations. The prespecified outbreak proxy was 3 or more versus 0-2 reported cases per county, a count threshold without verified epidemiologic linkage. A secondary, exploratory outcome was total case burden among counties with 3 or more cases. Firth penalized logistic regression estimated odds ratios (ORs) for occurrence; negative binomial regression with a log county-population offset and state-clustered robust standard errors estimated incidence rate ratios (IRRs) for burden. Models adjusted for percentage foreign-born, metropolitan status, population density, percentage uninsured, college education, 2024 presidential vote share, and primary care physician supply; estimates are per 1-percentage-point increase. Sensitivity analyses varied the threshold and adjustment set and examined spatial dependence, international airport proximity, state exclusions, and modified Poisson estimation. Only aggregate, publicly available data were analyzed; the study was exempt from institutional review. Results: The sample comprised 1914 counties in 30 states (237 million residents, 71.6% of the US population), capturing 1821 of 2214 reported 2025 cases (82.2%); 66 counties (3.4%) met the outbreak proxy. Mean (SD) MMR coverage was 91.1% (7.2%) and mean NME rate 4.58% (4.37%). In the joint model, each 1-percentage-point higher NME rate was associated with higher odds of meeting the proxy (OR 1.16; 95% CI 1.09-1.24; P<.001), whereas average MMR coverage was not (OR 1.01; 95% CI 0.96 1.07; P=.78). The exemption association persisted across thresholds of 1 to 10 or more cases (ORs 1.12-1.17), with reduced adjustment (OR 1.15), airport-proximity adjustment (OR 1.16), and modified Poisson estimation (risk ratio 1.14; 95% CI 1.06-1.23). Residual spatial autocorrelation was present (Moran I 0.0758; P=.001), and adding neighboring counties' exemption rates attenuated the OR to 1.12 (95% CI 1.03-1.20). In the exploratory burden model, the IRR was 1.08 (95% CI 1.00-1.16; P=.046), with confidence intervals crossing the null in several specifications. Conclusions: Across US counties in 2025, kindergarten nonmedical exemption rates were associated with clustered measles case reports independently of average MMR coverage, which carried little additional information once exemptions were considered. Estimates are ecological, not individual-level or causal; the count proxy did not establish epidemiologic linkage, and exposure definitions varied across states. Routinely collected school-entry exemption data may nonetheless complement local knowledge when pediatricians, school health programs, and health departments prioritize school-level review and outbreak preparedness.

papers.title: Divergent estimates of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis risk after measles and the projected burden of the 2023–2026 resurgence: a Bayesian modelling study
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Published estimates of the risk of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis after measles differ more than tenfold, and the burden of the 2023–2026 measles resurgence is unknown. We examined why and projected that burden. Methods Nine populations with counts of subacute sclerosing panencephalitis and measles denominators were identified from the literature, and a structured search of three databases checked completeness. Counts were expressed as observed/expected ratios under the 1991 England and Wales reference model. Bayesian hierarchical Poisson models compared study design and the way measles infections were counted (a covariate specified after earlier analyses) as explanations for differences between populations, assessed by leave-one-out cross-validation, permutation tests and 30 prespecified sensitivity analyses. Risk per infection was then applied to infections implied by measles cases reported to the World Health Organization from January 2023 to mid-October 2026. Results The populations contributed 499 cases; observed/expected ratios ranged from 0.33 to 8.14. The three populations whose denominators estimated all infections had ratios of 1.6 or less, whereas five of six with denominators counting notifications or clinic visits had ratios of about 4 to 8 (ratio 6.7, 95% credible interval 2.1–19.3). Study design fitted about as well (ratio 5.5, 1.6–16.9); the two explanations could not be separated. Relative to older ages, risk after infection in infancy was about twice that assumed by the reference (multiplier 2.1, 1.2–3.5), although the interval included 1 when either of two strata was omitted. The reported cases correspond to about 40 million infections, which are projected to cause a median of 1,564 (95% interval 254–10,376) to 2,601 (379–18,509) cases depending on the explanation, or about half if scaled to officially reported cases. More than 90% of onsets will occur after 2026, peaking around 2030. Conclusions How measles infections were counted may explain much of this variation but cannot be separated from study design; published risks should not be transferred between settings without accounting for the denominator. Under either explanation, the 2023–2026 resurgence is projected to cause hundreds to thousands of cases, mostly during 2027–2035, leaving time to strengthen surveillance and protect infants.

papers.title: Measles: from elimination to resurgence. A literature review and current recommendations
papers.abstract: Measles is a highly contagious, vaccine-preventable viral disease of mandatory epidemiological reporting that remains an active global public health threat. Caused by the measles virus (Paramyxoviridae family), a single-serotype pathogen with a basic reproduction number of 12-18, it is transmitted via aerosolized respiratory droplets. The classic clinical presentation begins with a prodrome of fever, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis, followed by Koplik’s spots and a characteristic cephalocaudal maculopapular rash. Diagnosis is confirmed through specific IgM serology, polymerase chain reaction or viral culture. Management is primarily supportive; vitamin A supplementation reduces childhood mortality by up to 62% and is universally recommended by the WHO for all diagnosed children. Complications occur in approximately 30% of cases; the most frequent and usually mild include diarrhea (8%) and otitis media (7-9%), while severe complications include pneumonia, diarrhea, acute encephalitis, acute post-infectious measles encephalomyelitis, and, years later, subacute sclerosing panencephalitis. The most vulnerable populations include children under 5, young adults without prior immunization, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. The MMR vaccine (measles, mumps and rubella) achieves 97% efficacy after two doses and requires population coverage above 93% to sustain herd immunity. In Mexico, declining vaccination rates contributed to more than 12,000 confirmed cases and over 33 deaths accumulated during the 2025–2026 outbreak, predominantly in unvaccinated children. Post-exposure prophylaxis with MMR within 72 hours or immunoglobulin within 6 days is indicated for susceptible high-risk individuals. Global coordination, sustained vaccination campaigns, and heightened clinical awareness remain essential to curb transmission. This article was prepared to provide a comprehensive review of measles, covering the associated risks, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.

Diagnosis is confirmed through specific IgM serology, polymerase chain reaction or viral culture. Management is primarily supportive; vitamin A supplementation reduces childhood mortality by up to 62% and is universally recommended by the WHO for all diagnosed children. The most vulnerable populations include children under 5, young adults without prior immunization, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. The MMR vaccine (measles, mumps and rubella) achieves 97% efficacy after two doses and requires population coverage above 93% to sustain herd immunity. In Mexico, declining vaccination rates contributed to more than 12,000 confirmed cases and over 33 deaths accumulated during the 2025–2026 outbreak, predominantly in unvaccinated children. Post-exposure prophylaxis with MMR within 72 hours or immunoglobulin within 6 days is indicated for susceptible high-risk individuals. Global coordination, sustained vaccination campaigns, and heightened clinical awareness remain essential to curb transmission. This article was prepared to provide a comprehensive review of measles, covering the associated risks, diagnosis, treatment, and prevention.

papers.title: SVIR Model Analysis of Measles with Incomplete Vaccination and 1 Waning Immunity: Sidoarjo-Indonesia Case
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.journal: CAUCHY Jurnal Matematika Murni dan Aplikasi

papers.title_zh: 具有不完整 疫苗接种 和 1 个免疫力减弱的 麻疹 的 SVIR 模型分析:Sidoarjo-Indonesia 案例
papers.source_body_en: Measles remains a significant public health challenge in Indonesia, especially in regionswith heterogeneous vaccination coverage and waning immunity. This study develops andanalyzes a Susceptible–Vaccinated–Infected–Recovered (SVIR) compartmental model formeasles transmission in Sidoarjo City, Indonesia, incorporating waning immunity. The basicreproduction number R0 is derived using the next-generation matrix method, and the globalstability of both the disease-free and endemic equilibria is rigorously proven via Lyapunovfunctions. Model parameters are estimated from weekly 2023 surveillance data in Sidoarjo Cityusing Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO), Extended Kalman Filter, Maximum LikelihoodEstimation, and Least Squares, and evaluated via Mean Absolute Percentage Error (MAPE).PSO achieves the lowest MAPE (11.17%), outperforming the other methods. The estimatedR0 = 0.668confirms a disease-free regime. Normalized sensitivity analysis identifies vaccineefficacy as the most influential parameter; a decline in efficacy to0 .75elevates R0 close tothe critical threshold, and any further reduction pushes the system into an endemic state.These findings underscore the necessity of maintaining high vaccine efficacy through boosterprograms and strengthened immunization strategies to sustain measles elimination at thedistrict level.
papers.abstract_zh: 麻疹仍然是印度尼西亚的重大公共卫生挑战,尤其是在疫苗接种覆盖率异质性和免疫力下降的地区。本研究开发并分析了一个针对麻疹传播的易感-接种-感染-康复(SVIR)分组模型,该模型纳入了免疫力下降的因素。基本再生数R0是通过下一代矩阵方法推导的,并且通过李雅普诺夫函数严格证明了无病平衡态和地方性平衡态的全局稳定性。模型参数是从2023年Sidoarjo市每周的监测数据中使用粒子群优化(PSO)、扩展卡尔曼滤波、最大似然估计和最小二乘法进行估计,并通过平均绝对百分比误差(MAPE)进行评估。PSO方法实现了最低的MAPE(11.17%),优于其他方法。估计的R0 = 0.668确认了无病状态。归一化敏感性分析确定疫苗效力是最关键的参数;疫苗效力下降至0 .75会使R0接近临界阈值,任何进一步的减少都会使系统进入地方性状态。这些发现强调了通过加强剂接种计划和强化疫苗接种策略保持高疫苗效力的必要性,以在区级维持麻疹的消除。

papers.title: Risk factors associated with the resurgence of confirmed measles cases in Senegal in the post Covid-19 period
papers.abstract: Measles is one of the most contagious infectious diseases, responsible for significant morbidity and mortality through recurring epidemics. In Senegal, a resurgence of confirmed measles cases was observed, with epidemics occurring between 2021 and 2024. The goal of this study is to identify factors significantly associated with laboratory-confirmed status among notified measles cases in Senegal in the post-Covid-19 context. A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted on all suspected measles cases notified in the health districts of Senegal from January 2015 to December 2024 ( n = 9 935), each classified as confirmed, doubtful, or ruled out. Confirmed cases were described separately ( n = 2 448). Statistical analyses were performed using R software with Cramér’s V, Multiple Correspondence Analysis, and multivariable binary logistic regression comparing confirmed cases with doubtful/ruled-out cases. Among 9 935 suspected measles cases notified over the study period, 2 448 were laboratory-confirmed. Patients ranged in age from 1 to 81 years, with a mean age of 9 years. Several factors were associated with laboratory-confirmed status. The Kédougou region (OR: 5, 95% CI [3.71–6.78], p < 2.2e- 16 ) was associated with a fivefold increased risk of a confirmed measles case. Insufficient vaccination coverage for the second dose (RR2) was strongly linked to confirmed status (OR: 3.34, 95% CI [2.83–3.95], p < 2.2e- 16 ). The risk was also four times higher in unvaccinated individuals (OR: 4.03, 95% CI [3.54–4.6], p < 2.2e- 16 ). Finally, children aged 1 to 5 years (OR: 1.39, 95% CI [1.24–1.55], p = 0.0003593) appear to be a particularly vulnerable age group, with an increased risk compared to other age groups. This study identified and ranked the principal risk factors associated with the resurgence of confirmed measles cases in Senegal. These findings could inform future research exploring machine-learning-based approaches to outbreak risk prediction; however, the development and validation of any such decision-support tool remain beyond the scope of the present analysis.

papers.title_zh: Covid-19 后时期与塞内加尔 麻疹 确诊病例复发相关的风险因素
papers.source_body_en: Measles is one of the most contagious infectious diseases, responsible for significant morbidity and mortality through recurring epidemics. In Senegal, a resurgence of confirmed measles cases was observed, with epidemics occurring between 2021 and 2024. The goal of this study is to identify factors significantly associated with laboratory-confirmed status among notified measles cases in Senegal in the post-Covid-19 context. A cross-sectional analytical study was conducted on all suspected measles cases notified in the health districts of Senegal from January 2015 to December 2024 ( n = 9 935), each classified as confirmed, doubtful, or ruled out. Confirmed cases were described separately ( n = 2 448). Statistical analyses were performed using R software with Cramér’s V, Multiple Correspondence Analysis, and multivariable binary logistic regression comparing confirmed cases with doubtful/ruled-out cases. Among 9 935 suspected measles cases notified over the study period, 2 448 were laboratory-confirmed. Patients ranged in age from 1 to 81 years, with a mean age of 9 years. Several factors were associated with laboratory-confirmed status. The Kédougou region (OR: 5, 95% CI [3.71–6.78], p < 2.2e- 16 ) was associated with a fivefold increased risk of a confirmed measles case. Insufficient vaccination coverage for the second dose (RR2) was strongly linked to confirmed status (OR: 3.34, 95% CI [2.83–3.95], p < 2.2e- 16 ). The risk was also four times higher in unvaccinated individuals (OR: 4.03, 95% CI [3.54–4.6], p < 2.2e- 16 ). Finally, children aged 1 to 5 years (OR: 1.39, 95% CI [1.24–1.55], p = 0.0003593) appear to be a particularly vulnerable age group, with an increased risk compared to other age groups. This study identified and ranked the principal risk factors associated with the resurgence of confirmed measles cases in Senegal. These findings could inform future research exploring machine-learning-based approaches to outbreak risk prediction; however, the development and validation of any such decision-support tool remain beyond the scope of the present analysis.

papers.title: Wastewater-Based Surveillance as a Complementary Tool for Measles Outbreak Detection in Under-Vaccinated Communities in Israel
papers.abstract: Measles outbreaks have re-emerged globally, particularly in communities with suboptimal vaccination coverage, highlighting the need for complementary surveillance approaches. We evaluated wastewater-based epidemiology (WBE) as a tool for detecting and monitoring measles virus (MeV) outbreaks in Israel during 2025. Weekly wastewater samples were collected from seven surveillance catchments between June and December 2025, concentrated using membrane filtration, and analyzed by digital PCR (dPCR). Environmental findings were compared with laboratory-confirmed measles cases assigned to the corresponding wastewater catchments. MeV RNA was detected in only two of the seven monitored sites, Beit Shemesh and Safed, both serving communities with low vaccination coverage (<82%). In these catchments, wastewater MeV RNA concentrations closely mirrored the dynamics of laboratory-confirmed cases, while no MeV RNA was detected in the remaining five sites despite continuous surveillance. In Safed, increases in wastewater MeV RNA concentrations preceded the rise in laboratory-confirmed cases by approximately one week, demonstrating the potential of WBE as an early-warning system. Our findings demonstrate that wastewater surveillance is a valuable epidemiological tool that complements conventional surveillance and has the potential to improve situational awareness of measles outbreaks, assist public health decision-making, and facilitate targeted interventions in vulnerable populations.

papers.title: Adaptive Sliding Mode Control for Vaccination and Treatment in a Measles Transmission Model
papers.abstract: Measles remains a highly contagious vaccine-preventable disease, and persistent outbreaks highlight the need for effective intervention strategies combining prevention and treatment. This study develops an extended measles transmission model consisting of susceptible, vaccinated, exposed, infectious, hospitalized, and recovered populations, with two time-dependent control inputs representing vaccination and treatment. An Adaptive Sliding Mode Control (ASMC) strategy is proposed to regulate the vaccinated population toward a prescribed trajectory while suppressing the infectious population. Normalized sliding surfaces are constructed for the vaccinated and infectious states, and adaptive gains incorporating a dead-zone mechanism are introduced to prevent unnecessary gain growth. The positivity and boundedness of the epidemiological model solutions are established, while Lyapunov analysis demonstrates exponential convergence of the ideal sliding dynamics when the control saturation constraints are inactive. Numerical simulations are conducted over 200 weeks with an initial population of 10 million individuals, comparing the proposed ASMC strategy with an uncontrolled scenario under the same initial conditions and epidemiological parameters. The uncontrolled infectious population reaches a peak of approximately (364,005) individuals, whereas under ASMC it does not exceed its initial value of (75,900), corresponding to a (79.15%) reduction in the peak infectious population relative to the uncontrolled scenario. papers.title: Digital PCR Triplex Assay for the Detection and Differentiation of Wild-Type and Vaccine-Strain Measles Viruses v1
papers.abstract: This protocol describes an optimised triplex digital PCR (dPCR) assay for the detection of measles virus RNA in wastewater and the differentiation of wild-type and vaccine-strain meas measles virus. The assay uses the QIAcuity OneStep Advanced Probe Kit with hydrolysis probes in multiplex reactions on QIAGEN QIAcuity digital PCR instruments. The protocol also provides instructions for the preparation of in-house 20× primer–probe assay mixes. The triplex assay was developed to improve the sensitivity of measles virus surveillance in wastewater by incorporating multiple detection targets into a single reaction. Its implementation has demonstrated an improvement in the overall measles virus detection rate (positivity rate) compared with the use of individual assays. Although the assay is designed to differentiate between wild-type and vaccine-strain measles virus, successful detection of measles virus RNA without definitive strain differentiation should still be considered a valuable surveillance outcome. In such cases, the sample should be reported as measles virus-positive, with strain differentiation recorded as inconclusive. Where definitive strain characterisation is required, whole-genome sequencing (WGS) is recommended. The complementary measles virus whole-genome sequencing protocol provides detailed instructions for the sequencing of measles virus detected in wastewater, enabling further genetic characterisation and strain identification.

source_records.title: Digital PCR Triplex Assay for the Detection and Differentiation of Wild-Type and Vaccine-Strain Measles Viruses v2
source_records.abstract: This protocol describes an optimised triplex digital PCR (dPCR) assay for the detection of measles virus RNA in wastewater and the differentiation of wild-type and vaccine-strain meas measles virus. The assay uses the QIAcuity OneStep Advanced Probe Kit with hydrolysis probes in multiplex reactions on QIAGEN QIAcuity digital PCR instruments. The protocol also provides instructions for the preparation of in-house 20× primer–probe assay mixes. The triplex assay was developed to improve the sensitivity of measles virus surveillance in wastewater by incorporating multiple detection targets into a single reaction. Its implementation has demonstrated an improvement in the overall measles virus detection rate (positivity rate) compared with the use of individual assays. Although the assay is designed to differentiate between wild-type and vaccine-strain measles virus, successful detection of measles virus RNA without definitive strain differentiation should still be considered a valuable surveillance outcome. In such cases, the sample should be reported as measles virus-positive, with strain differentiation recorded as inconclusive. Where definitive strain characterisation is required, whole-genome sequencing (WGS) is recommended. The complementary measles virus whole-genome sequencing protocol provides detailed instructions for the sequencing of measles virus detected in wastewater, enabling further genetic characterisation and strain identification.

Pylori Norovirus Healthcare Associated Infections (HAI) Prevention Antibiotics Immunizations Vaccines Respiratory Infections Community-Acquired Pneumonia Measles Influenza Sexually Transmitted Diseases HIV / AIDS HPV HSV PrEP Skin & Soft Tissue Diseases MRSA Zoonotic & Vector-Borne Diseases Lyme Disease ZIKA Choose Topic Spotlight - Vaccines in America| Antibiotics Deconstructed| Bench to Bedside With SIDP| Antimicrobial Stewardship| Hepatitis Advertisement News|Articles|November 27, 2026 Nonmedical Vaccine Exemptions Linked to County Measles Outbreaks Counties with higher school-entry nonmedical exemption rates had greater odds of measles outbreaks in 2025, even after accounting for average MMR coverage, which showed no independent association. Advertisement Counties with higher school-entry nonmedical vaccine exemption rates had greater odds of measles outbreaks in 2025, even after accounting for average MMR coverage, according to the study authors of a research letter in JAMA Network Open.1 Each 1-percentage-point increase in the nonmedical exemption rate was associated with 16% higher odds of a county reporting at least 3 measles cases.1 The findings arrive as the US records its highest measles count since elimination was declared in 2000. They also come days after the Pan American Health Organization (PAHO) withdrew the country's elimination status.2,3 The authors examined whether exemption data reveal clusters of susceptible children, which county-wide coverage averages can hide. Researchers from the University of Washington, The Kinkaid School, and George Washington University conducted a cross-sectional ecological study of 1,914 counties across 30 states. These counties held 237,057,569 residents, or 71.6% of the US population. The sample captured 1,821 of the 2,214 measles cases (82.2%) logged in 2025 by the Johns Hopkins University US Measles Tracker.1 The primary outcome was an outbreak proxy of at least 3 reported cases in a county, met by 66 counties (3.4%). Mean kindergarten MMR coverage was 91.1%, and the mean nonmedical exemption rate was 4.58%. In the joint Firth penalized logistic regression model, higher exemption rates were associated with higher odds of meeting the proxy (OR, 1.16; 95% CI, 1.09-1.24; P < .001).1 MMR coverage showed no association with outbreak occurrence once exemptions were in the model (OR, 1.01; 95% CI, 0.96-1.07; P = .78). Under alternative case thresholds, ORs ranged from 1.12 to 1.17, and adjusting for airport proximity yielded an OR of 1.16. Adding neighboring-county exemption rates to address spatial autocorrelation attenuated the estimate to 1.12 (95% CI, 1.03-1.20).1 What You Need to Know Each 1-percentage-point increase in a county's nonmedical exemption rate was linked to 16% higher odds of reaching at least 3 measles cases (OR, 1.16; 95% CI, 1.09-1.24). Average county MMR coverage did not predict outbreaks once exemptions were in the model, likely because county-wide averages hide clusters of susceptible children. The findings arrive as US measles cases reach 5,838 in 2026 and PAHO has withdrawn the country's measles elimination status. Higher exemption rates also tracked with lower county MMR coverage (exponentiated β, 0.93; 95% CI, 0.91-0.95; P < .001).1 In exploratory analyses, higher exemption rates were associated with greater case burden (IRR, 1.08; 95% CI, 1.00-1.16; P = .046).Burden estimates were less consistent, with CIs crossing the null in several specifications.1 According to the authors, the exemption signal may reflect clustering of susceptible children, differential measurement error, or both. They propose using exemption data alongside local knowledge when prioritizing school-level review and outbreak preparedness. However, the study did not test whether monitoring exemptions allows earlier outbreak detection.1 Because counties served as ecological units, the estimates cannot be read as individual-level or causal effects.The 3-case proxy does not establish epidemiologic linkage and could misclassify imported or cross-county outbreaks. Data from only 30 states, possible residual confounding by importation risk and surveillance intensity, and just 66 outcome events further limit the findings.1 US Measles Cases Climb as the Country Loses Elimination Status The CDC reported 5,838 confirmed measles cases as of November 19, according to Contagion's November 20 update. The count rose by 426 cases (7.9%) from the prior week and is about 2.6 times the 2,289 cases recorded in all of 2025. Cases span 47 jurisdictions, and 96% (5,629 of 5,838) are outbreak-associated.2 The CDC lists 591 hospitalizations (11%) and six deaths in 2026, while state health departments report 10 measles-associated deaths. Ninety-six percent of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination status. Kindergarten MMR coverage fell from 95.2% in 2019-2020 to 92.4% in 2025-2026, leaving about 280,000 kindergartners at risk.2 On November 17, PAHO Director Jarbas Barbosa announced the regional re-verification commission had found endemic transmission reestablished in the US, Bolivia, and Mexico. All three countries lost elimination status. To regain it, the US must submit a corrective action plan and go at least 12 months without endemic transmission.3 Large outbreaks remain active in Indiana, Minnesota, Pennsylvania, and Wisconsin, and New York State has declared a state of emergency. The CDC reports investing $100 million in state and local health departments as part of the response.2 References Ahmed HM, Kayani R, Yang YT. papers.title: About the measles epidemic in the Yakut region in 1900–1901
papers.abstract: Although measles outbreaks were repeatedly recorded in Yakutia during the pre-Soviet period, the largest outbreak, in 1900–1901, has not yet been described in detail in the scientific literature, and its documented scale has not been established from the available sources. To reconstruct, for the first time, the course and consequences of the largest measles epidemic in Yakutia in 1900–1901 and establish its documented scale using available archival sources. Materials & Methods. A comparative analysis was conducted of parish registers from 70 Orthodox churches and two mission stations in northeastern Russia. Records for 1899–1903 held by the National Archive of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia) and the State Archive of the Irkutsk Region were examined, with a focus on documented measles deaths. The earliest recorded measles deaths occurred in the Bodaibo area in the summer of 1899. In the spring of 1900, the infection spread to the Olekminsk and Vilyuisk districts. Mortality peaked in the Yakutsk district in November 1900, predominantly in the Lena–Amga interfluve. In the winter of 1900–1901, measles deaths were recorded in parish registers in the Verkhoyansk district, including the Bulun and Ust-Yana parishes beyond the Arctic Circle. From the beginning of 1901, measles spread widely across the Kolyma district along the Verkhoyansk–Kolyma route. The findings trace the spread of infection, describe the age and sex distribution of deaths and document the organization of assistance. The possible role of migration and living conditions in the epidemic is considered. Historical sources contribute to understanding past epidemiological processes and inform discussion of modern strategies for preventing infectious diseases. Particular attention is paid to mortality peaks, geographical coverage and the age and sex distribution of deaths. The proportion of adults among the deceased was higher in the Kolyma district than in the western and central districts. Low population immunity is considered only as a possible explanation for these differences. The Kolyma district illustrates the role of medical workers, political exiles and local residents in organizing assistance. The study demonstrates that a measles outbreak can develop into a large-scale disaster even in areas with low population density and limited transport infrastructure.

papers.title: Longitudinal study of the dynamics of post-vaccination humoral immunity against measles among staff of an infectious disease centre
papers.abstract: Measles remains a significant public health concern, and healthcare workers represent a high-risk group for infection and a potential source of nosocomial transmission. Data on the long-term dynamics of post-vaccination humoral immunity to measles among healthcare workers remain limited. To study the long-term dynamics of anti-measles IgG antibody levels among staff of a medical organization and to identify factors associated with the direction of these changes. Materials & Methods. A longitudinal study was conducted using serological screening data for measles IgG antibodies among staff of a medical organization collected from 2013 to 2025. Data from 571 measurements in 216 individuals with at least two IgG determinations by ELISA («VektoKor’ IgG» test system) were analyzed. A concentration ≥ 0.18 IU/mL was considered protective. The mean IgG concentration was 1.22 IU/mL, with a protective level recorded in 86.5 % of measurements. Ordinary linear regression across all 571 measurements yielded a negative slope (β = −0.058 IU/mL/year; R2 = 0.023). Within-participant dependence was not accounted for; therefore, the nominal p < 0.001 does not establish a statistically significant longitudinal trend. Participants were divided into groups according to the direction of IgG change with increasing (48.6 %), decreasing (41.7 %), and stable (9.7 %) titers; occupation was significantly associated with this distribution (an increase was more common among medical staff – 54.2 % vs 34.4 % among non-medical staff; p = 0.031). A strong negative correlation was found between the baseline IgG level and its subsequent annual change (r = –0.582; p < 0.0001), compatible with regression to the mean and mathematical coupling between baseline and change. Among twice-vaccinated individuals with an initially protective antibody level, IgG fell below 0.18 IU/mL at the last measurement in 2 of 41 participants (4.9 %). Measles IgG levels among staff of the infectious disease centre changed in different directions, with high inter-individual variability. IgG increases were more frequent among medical staff; the role of subclinical exposure to measles virus was not established by this study. Loss of the serological protective level in some twicevaccinated participants warrants further study; clinical protection and the effectiveness of additional vaccination were not assessed.

A strong negative correlation was found between the baseline IgG level and its subsequent annual change (r = –0.582; p < 0.0001), compatible with regression to the mean and mathematical coupling between baseline and change. Among twice-vaccinated individuals with an initially protective antibody level, IgG fell below 0.18 IU/mL at the last measurement in 2 of 41 participants (4.9 %). Measles IgG levels among staff of the infectious disease centre changed in different directions, with high inter-individual variability. IgG increases were more frequent among medical staff; the role of subclinical exposure to measles virus was not established by this study. Loss of the serological protective level in some twicevaccinated participants warrants further study; clinical protection and the effectiveness of additional vaccination were not assessed.

papers.abstract: Measles is one of the most contagious viral infections and remains a significant threat to public health, particularly among young children and individuals without immunity. Despite the availability of effective vaccines, measles outbreaks continue to occur in different countries due to insufficient vaccination coverage, population migration, and gaps in herd immunity. Modern measles prevention includes routine and supplementary immunization, epidemiological surveillance, early detection of cases, isolation of infected individuals, and public health education. Particular importance is given to increasing vaccination coverage among children and adults, especially those belonging to high-risk groups.

papers.title: Intensity of post-vaccination immunity against measles in children according to a retrospective study
papers.abstract: Objective: a retrospective assessment of the intensity of humoral immunity in children vaccinated against measles with various somatic diseases, depending on age and vaccination status. Materials and methods: A retrospective study included 171 patients aged 1 to 18 years who were exposed to anti-epidemic measures for contact with measles at the department of the Children's City Clinical Hospital No. The assessment of the intensity of humoral immunity was carried out by enzyme immunoassay. Results: Among children with documented vaccination, the proportion of seronegative patients among those vaccinated once between the ages of 1 and 6 years was 20.6%, among those vaccinated twice over the age of 6 years — 18.1%. There were no statistically significant differences between the proportions of patients ( p = 0.69). Conclusion: The high proportion of seronegative children among the vaccinated population exceeds the threshold recommended by Rospotrebnadzor of 7% among those vaccinated and requires further research.

papers.title: Clinical and Epidemiological Characteristics of Measles in the Belgorod Region
papers.abstract: Comparative analysis of epidemiological and clinical-laboratory features of measles course in children and adults in the Belgorod region for the period 2023—2025. Materials and methods. Retrospective analysis of medical records of 51 patients with a laboratory-confirmed diagnosis (IgM to measles virus). Analysis of measles morbidity in the Belgorod region (2023—2025) revealed that 90.1% of cases were registered among unvaccinated individuals. The share of imported cases was 37.3%, and intra-family contacts (59.4%) were the leading mode of transmission within the region. In 82.3% of patients, the disease was characterized by a typical moderate severity. The universality of the main symptoms (rhinitis, cough, and exanthem — 100%) was combined with age-related variability of additional markers: conjunctivitis and Belsky-Filatov-Koplik spots were more common in adults (71.4% and 80.9% vs. 46.6% and 43.3% in children). Laboratory signs of systemic inflammation (accelerated ESR, increased CRP) also prevailed in the adult group. analysis.research_question_and_background: This study aimed to compare the epidemiological and clinical-laboratory features of measles in children and adults in the Belgorod region during 2023—2025, addressing the knowledge gap regarding the disease's variability across age groups.
analysis.study_design_and_population: A retrospective analysis of medical records was conducted on 51 patients with a laboratory-confirmed diagnosis of measles virus infection in the Belgorod region between 2023 and 2025.
analysis.methods: The study involved reviewing medical records to analyze epidemiological and clinical-laboratory features of measles cases, including age distribution, transmission modes, and symptom prevalence.
analysis.main_results: The analysis revealed that 90.1% of measles cases in the Belgorod region were registered among unvaccinated individuals, with 37.3% of cases being imported and intra-family contacts accounting for 59.4% of transmission within the region.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study highlights the significant role of unvaccinated individuals in measles transmission and the dominance of intra-family spread, offering novel insights into the epidemiological patterns of measles in the region.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings underscore the importance of vaccination programs and public health measures targeting unvaccinated populations and family-based transmission dynamics in controlling measles outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study is based on retrospective medical records, which may introduce recall bias, and the evidence is limited to the Belgorod region, reducing generalizability. The evidence strength is moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study conducted a comparative analysis of measles epidemiological and clinical-laboratory features in children and adults in the Belgorod region from 2023 to 2025. It found that 90.1% of cases were among unvaccinated individuals, with 37.3% being imported and intra-family contacts accounting for 59.4% of transmission. The disease was typically moderate in severity (82.3% of patients), but adults showed higher rates of severe disease and complications. The study emphasizes the need for targeted vaccination and public health interventions to address unvaccinated populations and family-based transmission. However, the retrospective design and regional focus limit the generalizability of the findings, resulting in moderate evidence strength.

papers.title: Oncolytic measles virus reprograms the tumor microenvironment in a vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip model
papers.abstract: Abstract Background Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a rare and aggressive cancer primarily caused by asbestos exposure. Although dual immune checkpoint inhibition (anti-PD-1/anti-CTLA-4) is now approved as first-line therapy, clinical benefit is limited to a small subset of patients, necessitating the need for alternative strategies. Oncolytic viruses represent a promising therapeutic approach as they selectively infect and lyse tumor cells and display immunogenic properties. In PM, we showed that the oncolytic activity of measles virus (MV) is primarily dependent on alterations in the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. However, to date no in vitro models have yet been developed to mimic a sophisticated tumor microenvironment (TME), and accurately evaluate MV efficacy in PM. Methods We designed a humanized 3D “vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip” (VMOC) model using microfluidic chips that mimic a TME. VMOCs are generated using primary endothelial cells, lung fibroblasts and patient-derived PM cells. We characterized the functionality of our model by confocal imaging, perfusion assay and single-cell RNA sequencing. The impact of MV on the VMOC was assessed by bulk transcriptomics, multiplex ELISA and deconvolution strategies, and compared to clinical data in patients with PM. Results We first proved VMOC functionality with an appropriate endothelial barrier integrity, perfusability, and vascular responsiveness to external stimuli. We demonstrated significant heterogeneity in the VMOC, with the presence of different mesenchymal, cancer and endothelial subpopulations. Interestingly, the addition of PM cells to the VMOC reduced both the IFN-I pathway in cells from the TME, and the abundance of a novel endothelial cell subset characterized by an IFN-I signaling signature. Following MV administration via the endothelial network, we detected PM cell infection and death, as well as strong activation of the IFN-I pathway with the production of multiple inflammatory mediators. Interestingly, the proteomic and transcriptomic inflammatory response induced by MV in VMOCs was similar to that induced in PM patients treated with an oncolytic virus. Conclusions The VMOC model we developed enables in vitro investigation of MV infection and TME reprogramming, paving the way for a deeper understanding of the TME role in OV responses and the development of novel strategies to improve clinical efficacy.

source_records.title: Oncolytic measles virus reprograms the tumor microenvironment in a vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip model
source_records.abstract: Background Pleural mesothelioma (PM) is a rare and aggressive cancer primarily caused by asbestos exposure. Although dual immune checkpoint inhibition (anti-PD-1/anti-CTLA-4) is now approved as first-line therapy, clinical benefit is limited to a small subset of patients, necessitating the need for alternative strategies. Oncolytic viruses represent a promising therapeutic approach as they selectively infect and lyse tumor cells and display immunogenic properties. In PM, we showed that the oncolytic activity of measles virus (MV) is primarily dependent on alterations in the type I interferon (IFN-I) pathway. However, to date no in vitro models have yet been developed to mimic a sophisticated tumor microenvironment (TME), and accurately evaluate MV efficacy in PM. Methods We designed a humanized 3D “vascularized mesothelioma-on-chip” (VMOC) model using microfluidic chips that mimic a TME. VMOCs are generated using primary endothelial cells, lung fibroblasts and patient-derived PM cells. We characterized the functionality of our model by confocal imaging, perfusion assay and single-cell RNA sequencing. The impact of MV on the VMOC was assessed by bulk transcriptomics, multiplex ELISA and deconvolution strategies, and compared to clinical data in patients with PM. Results We first proved VMOC functionality with an appropriate endothelial barrier integrity, perfusability, and vascular responsiveness to external stimuli. We demonstrated significant heterogeneity in the VMOC, with the presence of different mesenchymal, cancer and endothelial subpopulations. Interestingly, the addition of PM cells to the VMOC reduced both the IFN-I pathway in cells from the TME, and the abundance of a novel endothelial cell subset characterized by an IFN-I signaling signature. Following MV administration via the endothelial network, we detected PM cell infection and death, as well as strong activation of the IFN-I pathway with the production of multiple inflammatory mediators. Interestingly, the proteomic and transcriptomic inflammatory response induced by MV in VMOCs was similar to that induced in PM patients treated with an oncolytic virus. Conclusions The VMOC model we developed enables in vitro investigation of MV infection and TME reprogramming, paving the way for a deeper understanding of the TME role in OV responses and the development of novel strategies to improve clinical efficacy.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在满足体外模型的需求,以评估溶瘤剂 麻疹病毒 (MV) 对胸膜间皮瘤 (PM) 的疗效,这是一种主要由石棉暴露引起的罕见且侵袭性癌症。尽管双重免疫检查点抑制现已被批准作为一线治疗,但临床获益仅限于一小部分患者,因此需要替代策略。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用微流控芯片设计了人性化 3D“芯片上血管化间皮瘤”(VMOC) 模型来模拟 PM 的肿瘤微环境 (TME)。该模型是使用原代内皮细胞、肺成纤维细胞和患者来源的 PM 细胞生成的。
elements_zh.methods: VMOC 模型通过共聚焦成像、灌注测定和单细胞 RNA 测序进行表征。使用批量转录组学、多重 ELISA 和反卷积策略评估 MV 对 VMOC 的影响,并与 PM 患者的临床数据进行比较。
elements_zh.main_results: VMOC 功能通过适当的内皮屏障完整性、灌注性和血管对外部刺激的反应性得到证实。该模型表现出不同间充质、癌症和内皮亚群存在的显着异质性。通过内皮网络施用 MV 导致 PM 细胞感染和死亡,以及 I 型干扰素 (IFN-I) 途径的强烈激活,并产生多种炎症介质。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究表明,MV 在 PM 中的溶瘤活性主要依赖于 IFN-I 途径的改变。VMOC模型能够对MV感染和TME重编程进行体外研究,为更深入地了解TME在OV反应中的作用以及开发提高临床疗效的新策略铺平了道路。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: VMOC 模型可用于研究 MV 感染和 TME 重编程,这可能导致开发新策略来提高 PM 的临床疗效。该模型提供了一个在更生理相关的环境中评估 MV 和其他溶瘤病毒的平台。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用非随机体外模型以及需要进一步体内验证。由于所提供的证据仅具有抽象性质,因此证据强度中等。

papers.abstract_zh: 摘要 背景 胸膜间皮瘤 (PM) 是一种罕见的侵袭性癌症,主要由石棉暴露引起。尽管双重免疫检查点抑制(抗 PD-1/抗 CTLA-4)现已被批准作为一线治疗,但临床获益仅限于一小部分患者,因此需要替代策略。溶瘤病毒代表了一种有前途的治疗方法,因为它们选择性地感染和裂解肿瘤细胞并表现出免疫原性。在 PM 中,我们发现 麻疹病毒 (MV) 的溶瘤活性主要依赖于 I 型干扰素 (IFN-I) 途径的改变。然而,迄今为止,尚未开发出体外模型来模拟复杂的肿瘤微环境 (TME),并准确评估 MV 对 PM 的疗效。方法我们使用模仿 TME 的微流控芯片设计了人性化 3D“芯片上血管化间皮瘤”(VMOC) 模型。VMOC 使用原代内皮细胞、肺成纤维细胞和患者来源的 PM 细胞产生。我们通过共聚焦成像、灌注测定和单细胞 RNA 测序来表征我们模型的功能。通过批量转录组学、多重 ELISA 和反卷积策略评估 MV 对 VMOC 的影响,并与 PM 患者的临床数据进行比较。结果我们首先证明了 VMOC 具有适当的内皮屏障完整性、可灌注性和血管对外部刺激的反应性的功能。我们证明了 VMOC 存在显着的异质性,存在不同的间充质、癌症和内皮亚群。有趣的是,将PM细胞添加到VMOC中既减少了来自TME的细胞中的IFN-I途径,也减少了以IFN-I信号传导特征为特征的新型内皮细胞亚群的丰度。通过内皮网络给予 MV 后,我们检测到 PM 细胞感染和死亡,以及 IFN-I 途径的强烈激活和多种炎症介质的产生。有趣的是,MV 在 VMOC 中诱导的蛋白质组和转录组炎症反应与用溶瘤病毒治疗的 PM 患者诱导的相似。结论 我们开发的 VMOC 模型能够对 MV 感染和 TME 重编程进行体外研究,为更深入地了解 TME 在 OV 反应中的作用以及开发提高临床疗效的新策略铺平道路。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在满足体外模型的需求,以评估溶瘤剂 麻疹病毒 (MV) 对胸膜间皮瘤 (PM) 的疗效,这是一种主要由石棉暴露引起的罕见且侵袭性癌症。尽管双重免疫检查点抑制现已被批准作为一线治疗,但临床获益仅限于一小部分患者,因此需要替代策略。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 使用微流控芯片设计了人性化 3D“芯片上血管化间皮瘤”(VMOC) 模型来模拟 PM 的肿瘤微环境 (TME)。该模型是使用原代内皮细胞、肺成纤维细胞和患者来源的 PM 细胞生成的。
analysis_zh.methods: VMOC 模型通过共聚焦成像、灌注测定和单细胞 RNA 测序进行表征。使用批量转录组学、多重 ELISA 和反卷积策略评估 MV 对 VMOC 的影响,并与 PM 患者的临床数据进行比较。
analysis_zh.main_results: VMOC 功能通过适当的内皮屏障完整性、灌注性和血管对外部刺激的反应性得到证实。该模型表现出不同间充质、癌症和内皮亚群存在的显着异质性。通过内皮网络施用 MV 导致 PM 细胞感染和死亡,以及 I 型干扰素 (IFN-I) 途径的强烈激活,并产生多种炎症介质。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 研究表明,MV 在 PM 中的溶瘤活性主要依赖于 IFN-I 途径的改变。VMOC模型能够对MV感染和TME重编程进行体外研究,为更深入地了解TME在OV反应中的作用以及开发提高临床疗效的新策略铺平了道路。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: VMOC 模型可用于研究 MV 感染和 TME 重编程,这可能导致开发新策略来提高 PM 的临床疗效。该模型提供了一个在更生理相关的环境中评估 MV 和其他溶瘤病毒的平台。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究的局限性包括使用非随机体外模型以及需要进一步体内验证。由于所提供的证据仅具有抽象性质,因此证据强度中等。

analysis.research_question_and_background: The study aimed to investigate the feasibility of using wastewater sequencing for scalable measles surveillance during outbreaks in South Africa, addressing the need for high-resolution tracking of virus spread and evolution.
analysis.study_design_and_population: The study employed whole-genome amplicon sequencing of wastewater samples from South Africa during the 2024–2025 measles outbreaks, involving multiple provinces and focusing on genotype prevalence and transmission links.
analysis.methods: Wastewater samples were enriched and total nucleic acid extracted using Dynabeads technology, followed by multiplex PCR-based whole-genome sequencing of measles virus.
analysis.main_results: Whole-genome sequencing of wastewater samples revealed shifts in genotype prevalence, detailed transmission links, and previously unreported interprovincial spread of measles virus.
analysis.interpretation_and_novelty: The study interpreted these findings as enabling high-resolution tracking of measles virus spread and evolution, which is novel in using wastewater sequencing for scalable surveillance.
analysis.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: The findings can inform surveillance, diagnosis, and treatment strategies for measles, enhancing public health responses to outbreaks.
analysis.limitations_and_evidence_strength: The study acknowledges limitations in design, such as the need for further validation and generalizability to other settings, and assesses the evidence strength as moderate.

analysis.summary_en: This study used wastewater sequencing to track measles virus spread and evolution during outbreaks in South Africa, demonstrating high-resolution surveillance capabilities.

elements_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查在南非 麻疹 期间使用废水测序进行可扩展的 麻疹 监测 的可行性,以满足对病毒传播和 进化 进行高分辨率跟踪的需求。
elements_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对2024年至2025年麻疹 暴发期间来自南非的废水样本进行了全基因组扩增子测序,涉及多个省份,重点关注基因型患病率和传播链接。
elements_zh.methods: 使用 Dynabeads 技术对废水样品进行富集并提取总核酸,然后对 麻疹病毒 进行基于多重 PCR 的全 基因组 测序。
elements_zh.main_results: 废水样本的全 基因组 测序揭示了基因型 患病率 的变化、详细的 传播 链接以及之前未报告的 麻疹病毒 的省际传播。
elements_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将这些发现解释为能够对 麻疹病毒 传播和 进化 进行高分辨率跟踪,这在使用废水测序实现可扩展的 监测 方面是新颖的。
elements_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为 麻疹 的 监测、诊断 和 治疗 策略提供信息,从而增强对 暴发 的公共卫生应对。
elements_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认设计上的局限性,例如需要进一步验证和推广到其他环境,并将证据强度评估为中等。

analysis_zh.research_question_and_background: 该研究旨在调查在南非 麻疹 期间使用废水测序进行可扩展的 麻疹 监测 的可行性,以满足对病毒传播和 进化 进行高分辨率跟踪的需求。
analysis_zh.study_design_and_population: 该研究对2024年至2025年麻疹 暴发期间来自南非的废水样本进行了全基因组扩增子测序,涉及多个省份,重点关注基因型患病率和传播链接。
analysis_zh.methods: 使用 Dynabeads 技术对废水样品进行富集并提取总核酸,然后对 麻疹病毒 进行基于多重 PCR 的全 基因组 测序。
analysis_zh.main_results: 废水样本的全 基因组 测序揭示了基因型 患病率 的变化、详细的 传播 链接以及之前未报告的 麻疹病毒 的省际传播。
analysis_zh.interpretation_and_novelty: 该研究将这些发现解释为能够对 麻疹病毒 传播和 进化 进行高分辨率跟踪,这在使用废水测序实现可扩展的 监测 方面是新颖的。
analysis_zh.scientific_and_public_health_significanc: 研究结果可以为 麻疹 的 监测、诊断 和 治疗 策略提供信息,从而增强对 暴发 的公共卫生应对。
analysis_zh.limitations_and_evidence_strength: 该研究承认设计上的局限性,例如需要进一步验证和推广到其他环境,并将证据强度评估为中等。

papers.title: Characterizing the relative strength of metapopulation dynamics in measles persistence
papers.abstract: Background/Aims Measles is a highly infectious, vaccine-preventable disease that remains persistent across much of the world despite continued large-scale control efforts. Local dynamics of measles are shaped by births of susceptible individuals and seasonal drivers of transmission, while broader regional dynamics are shaped by population mobility and metapopulation connectivity. Incidence data, useful for tracking the progress of measles control, are frequently reported only at the aggregate level (e.g., states/provinces), and persistence at this scale may arise because of the independent persistence in all local sub-units or because of regional metapopulation dynamics. Disentangling the contribution of local versus regional persistence is critical in identifying effective strategies for control. Methods/Results We show, as vaccination reduces local measles prevalence, metapopulation colonization and extinction events dominate regional persistence. This manifests as a change in the seasonal distribution of cases throughout the year; incidence becomes more uniformly distributed through the year even with no change in underlying seasonal drivers. We demonstrate this using: 1) a seasonally forced, stochastic metapopulation compartmental model; 2) historical measles incidence in the USA; and 3) recent subnational-level measles incidence in Nigeria. We create a novel, scale-free measure to quantify the contribution of metapopulation dynamics to persistence, roundness, defined as the geometric mean of the scaled maximum and minimum monthly incidence. A low value of roundness indicates strong local persistence dominated by the seasonal attractor, while a high value indicates strong metapopulation persistence. We illustrate the properties of this measure using simulations and observed data. In the USA, roundness nearly doubled after the introduction of the measles-containing vaccine. In Nigeria, roundness is well correlated with observed vaccine coverage, with a Pearson's r of 0.70 (95% CI: 0.57, 0.80), discriminating between northern states dominated by local persistence of measles and southern states where persistence is maintained by regional dynamics. Conclusion Identifying how measles persists is important in its control; vaccination strategies may differ if persistence is largely local, or if persistence is driven by connectivity from surrounding areas, even where yearly incidence is comparable. Our approach can be valuable areas where other measures (connectivity, mobility, laboratory confirmed illness) are not widely available.

source_records.abstract: Background/Aims Measles is a highly infectious, vaccine-preventable disease that remains persistent across much of the world despite continued large-scale control efforts. Local dynamics of measles are shaped by births of susceptible individuals and seasonal drivers of transmission, while broader regional dynamics are shaped by population mobility and metapopulation connectivity. Incidence data, useful for tracking the progress of measles control, are frequently reported only at the aggregate level (e.g., states/provinces), and persistence at this scale may arise because of the independent persistence in all local sub-units or because of regional metapopulation dynamics. Disentangling the contribution of local versus regional persistence is critical in identifying effective strategies for control. Methods/Results We show, as vaccination reduces local measles prevalence, metapopulation colonization and extinction events dominate regional persistence. This manifests as a change in the seasonal distribution of cases throughout the year; incidence becomes more uniformly distributed through the year even with no change in underlying seasonal drivers. We demonstrate this using: 1) a seasonally forced, stochastic metapopulation compartmental model; 2) historical measles incidence in the USA; and 3) recent subnational-level measles incidence in Nigeria. We create a novel, scale-free measure to quantify the contribution of metapopulation dynamics to persistence, roundness, defined as the geometric mean of the scaled maximum and minimum monthly incidence. A low value of roundness indicates strong local persistence dominated by the seasonal attractor, while a high value indicates strong metapopulation persistence. We illustrate the properties of this measure using simulations and observed data. In the USA, roundness nearly doubled after the introduction of the measles-containing vaccine. In Nigeria, roundness is well correlated with observed vaccine coverage, with a Pearson's r of 0.70 (95% CI: 0.57, 0.80), discriminating between northern states dominated by local persistence of measles and southern states where persistence is maintained by regional dynamics. Conclusion Identifying how measles persists is important in its control; vaccination strategies may differ if persistence is largely local, or if persistence is driven by connectivity from surrounding areas, even where yearly incidence is comparable. Our approach can be valuable areas where other measures (connectivity, mobility, laboratory confirmed illness) are not widely available.
